description: This Python script is an integration test for AWS IoT device SDK, testing offline queueing of subscribe/unsubscribe requests and message delivery stability across reconnects, involving multiple threads and client interactions.

classes.name: DualClientRunner
classes.description: Manages two MQTT clients for testing offline queueing, reconnection, and message delivery in a multi-threaded environment.

methods.name: get_random_string
methods.description: Generates a random lowercase string of specified length.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes DualClientRunner with mode, sets up clients, and subscribes to initial topics.

methods.name: _create_connected_client
methods.description: Creates and connects an MQTT client with specified ID prefix.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts client threads for publishing and subscription management.

methods.name: _thread_client_sub_unsub_runtime
methods.description: Manages offline subscription/unsubscription, waits for reconnection, and verifies message receipt.

methods.name: _wait_until_stable_connection
methods.description: Waits until the client connection reaches a stable state.

methods.name: _collect_sub_messages
methods.description: Collects messages received on subscribed topics.

methods.name: _go_offline_and_send_requests
methods.description: Simulates network errors to go offline and performs offline subscribe/unsubscribe.

methods.name: _manual_network_error
methods.description: Closes socket and SSL to simulate network disconnection.

methods.name: _thread_client_pub_runtime
methods.description: Handles publishing messages in two rounds, coordinating with offline events.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Checks that the expected number of messages were received on each topic.
